YGODUELIST-GRAVEYARD_RELIC.title: Graveyard
YGODUELIST-GRAVEYARD_RELIC.description: A special combat-only card zone. Cards are temporarily added during combat; the zone is empty outside of combat. Click to view graveyard cards when at least one is in it.
YGODUELIST-GRAVEYARD_RELIC.flavor: Cards laid to rest await their return.
YGODUELIST-SHADOW_REALM_RELIC.title: Shadow Realm
YGODUELIST-SHADOW_REALM_RELIC.descriptio: A combat-only zone for banished cards; it is cleared when combat ends. Click to view Shadow Realm cards when at least one is in it.
YGODUELIST-SHADOW_REALM_RELIC.flavor: What is banished is not gone—only elsewhere.
YGODUELIST-EXTRA_DECK_RELIC.title: Extra Deck
YGODUELIST-EXTRA_DECK_RELIC.description: Fusion monsters never stay in your main deck: they move here on the map and in combat. Click to view your Extra Deck when it has at least one card.
YGODUELIST-EXTRA_DECK_RELIC.flavor: Where impossible combinations wait to be made real.
YGODUELIST-CARD_OPTIONS_RELIC.title: Card Options
YGODUELIST-CARD_OPTIONS_RELIC.descriptio: Debug relic. Click to view whatever cards are currently in the card options pile during combat.
YGODUELIST-SPELL_TRAP_ZONE_RELIC.title: Spell/Trap Zone
YGODUELIST-SPELL_TRAP_ZONE_RELIC.descrip: The zone supports 5 non-field spell/trap cards plus one dedicated field spell slot.
